datasets.canonical_name: CBM and VBM database for ABX3 perovskites
raw_names: conduction band minimum (CBM) and valence band maximum(VBM)

evidence.text: The establishment of ML prediction models for conduction band minimum (CBM) and valence band maximum(VBM). Because the data features are similar to features of bandgap, the prediction models of CBM and VBM are directly adopted the Xgboost algorithm without algorithm screening. The CBM and VBM databases contain 115 valid data points.

raw_names: DFT calculations on the bandgap values of the perovskites with 3 different compositions

evidence.text: We have also conducted the comparison with the DFT calculations on the bandgap values of the perovskites with 3 different compositions, which are new to our ML model.

As shown in Tables 2 and 3, for the bandgap calculation of MASnxPb1-xI3, the RMSE between the predicted ML value and the experimental value is 0.049 eV; the RMSE between the calculated DFT value and the experimental value is 0.052 eV.

evidence.text: To verify the accuracy of our ML model and predication ability for new perovskites, we synthesize the Cs0.05(FA0.85MA0.15)0.95Pb(I0.85Br0.15)3 perovskite thin films for bandgap determination. ... dataset_uses.purpose: DFT-calculated bandgap values used to computationally validate ML predictions on unseen compositions

evidence.text: We have also conducted the comparison with the DFT calculations on the bandgap values of the perovskites with 3 different compositions, which are new to our ML model. The prediction result of ML and the comparison are shown in Table S12. It is found that the bandgap values obtained by ML model are very close to the values of the DFT calculations.
